entity.summary: Decentralized on-chain trading protocol combining permissionless token listing, automated market making, and order-book functionality, now in a shutdown wind-down with all OneSwap services scheduled to cease on September 29, 2026.
entity.notes: OneSwap's first-party help center says all services will discontinue at 02:00 UTC on September 29, 2026 because CoinEx Smart Chain (CSC) and CoinEx Exchange are being discontinued. HEI records the present wind-down as limited and leaves death_date null until the scheduled cessation is confirmed. CoinEx documentation describes OneSwap as an on-chain trading platform with permissionless listing, AMM, and order-book functionality.

events.title: OneSwap announced discontinuation of all services
events.description: OneSwap announced that all services would discontinue at 02:00 UTC on September 29, 2026 in connection with the shutdown of CoinEx Smart Chain and the CoinEx exchange platform.
events.notes: This is an announced future terminal shutdown. HEI does not emit shutdown_effective or set death_date until the scheduled cessation is confirmed.

evidence.title: Announcement on the Discontinuation of OneSwap Services
evidence.notes: First-party OneSwap notice stating that all services will discontinue at 02:00 UTC on September 29, 2026 and instructing liquidity providers to withdraw assets before shutdown.

evidence.title: Important Notice on CoinEx’s Orderly Cessation of Operations
evidence.notes: CoinEx's first-party final announcement independently states that OneSwap and CoinEx Smart Chain will cease operations on September 29, 2026.

evidence.title: CoinEx Will List ONES and Start Mining: Lock CET to Share 20,000,000 ONES
evidence.notes: CoinEx describes OneSwap as an on-chain one-stop trading platform built on CoinEx Smart Chain with permissionless token listing, automated market making, and order-book functionality.

evidence.title: OneSwap exchange profile
evidence.notes: CoinMarketCap's exchange profile states that OneSwap launched on September 18, 2020 and describes its AMM and order-book model.
